_comment: Test plan (user 2026-10-25: tests are built alongside the mod). Each feature needs at least `min` DIFFERENT in-game tests passing whose id starts with `prefix` (SCOPE-TEST pass <id>). A new feature = a new line here in the same change. Never lower a min or remove a line to get a push through. Useleess Carpet: launcher + patch for a 1.12.2 Carpet server; in-game = real servers from the launcher jar (ingame-test.sh, test box). Bulk tests are unit tests in mod/src/test.

features.what: launcher install: download from Mojang, installer deletes itself (install-only + after the server stops), folder left clean, built jar contents, owner's own Mojang jar kept, server jar reused, 0.1.0 folder removed
server from the launcher: boot, VasTech / Kisde / Bullet rules, Redstone Scope loaded, clean stop

double-click installer window (user 2026-10-30): our own start-useleess-carpet.bat made, the owner's scripts never changed, EULA asked, Java 8 found, server started in its own window, installer removed, the made script starts the server

our own Carpet rules: listed, saved, endPortalNoTeleportPlayer, redstoneScopeLogger (listed, off/on, saved), antiNoFall (listed, off = vanilla, on = a no-fall cheat is hurt like an honest fall, honest falls unchanged), litematicaShulkerRestock (listed, off refused, wrong item refused, on moves the stack out of the box)

careful break per player (/log carefulBreak [sneak|always]): default needs Sneak, always needs no Sneak, not subscribed = drops on the ground, rule carefulBreak off = ground, the choice is remembered over a server restart

op-made custom recipes (rule customRecipes, /customrecipe): survival op opens the one-window editor, category / paging / anvil search, build + save, crafting works, any order, clear, all recipes (load, overwrite, delete), refused saves, exit / close / disconnect / killed server restore the inventory exactly, no item can leave, non-op and rule-off refused, restart keeps recipes, bad file skipped
